subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The police inspector knows the __ins and outs__ of the murder case.
solution:
The correct answer is: **full details**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"ins and outs"** means all the details or intricacies of a particular situation or subject. (विस्तृत जानकारी)

 
 
• **Example:** She knows the ins and outs of the project, which makes her indispensable to the team.
 
 
 
• **"Full details"** refers to having complete and comprehensive information about something. (पूर्ण विवरण)
 
 
• **Example:** The report contained the full details of the investigation.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **full details.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Laws** (कानून): Rules established by a governing authority to regulate behavior.

 
 
• **Example:** Citizens are expected to abide by the laws of the country.
 
 
 
• **All the witnesses** (सभी गवाह): Every person who has seen or can give a firsthand account of an event.
 
 
• **Example:** The prosecutor called all the witnesses to testify in court.
 
 
 
• **Lawyers and judges** (वकील और जज): Legal professionals who represent clients and adjudicate legal matters.
 
 
• **Example:** Lawyers and judges play crucial roles in the justice system.
